name: The Undead of Umerilek
description: Undead in lace and rings who rise from their coffins in Umerilek.

timeline.summary: The coffins open and the undead rise of their own accord, as Vraska had told him they would.
timeline.quote: the undead began to rise of their own accord, just as Vraska had told him they would.
